What does a chief of staff do?

A chief of staff is a senior right hand to an executive: they turn the executive's priorities into action by running the agenda, following up on decisions, keeping projects aligned with goals and making sure nothing important waits on the executive's memory.

Quick answer

A chief of staff makes sure an executive's time goes to what matters and that decisions turn into action. Most people never get one. An AI chief of staff does the routine part of the job for one person: the daily agenda, the follow-ups and keeping projects lined up.

Best for: Anyone asking what the role involves, and people wondering whether they could have the same help without a hire.

What are a chief of staff's main duties?

The job varies by company, but it usually comes down to time, follow-through and alignment.

  • Priorities and time: deciding what reaches the executive and in what order.
  • Follow-through: making sure decisions and promises turn into action.
  • Alignment: keeping projects and people pointed at the same goals.
  • Preparation: getting meetings, briefs and the week ready ahead of time.
  • Gatekeeping: handling what does not need the executive at all.

How is a chief of staff different from an executive assistant?

An executive assistant runs the day; a chief of staff runs the priorities behind it.

What differsExecutive assistantChief of staff
FocusThe calendar, travel, email and the dayPriorities, projects and follow-through
Time frameToday and this weekThis quarter and this year
Question it answers"Where do I need to be?""Is this the right thing to spend time on?"

Can AI do a chief of staff's job for one person?

It can do the routine, daily part: the agenda, the follow-ups and keeping goals and projects lined up.

What AI does not bring is a person's judgement and relationships. What it does bring is consistency: it is there every morning and it does not forget. In A Player Mode, Chief of Staff is one of five roles, described as strategic alignment between projects, priorities and long-term goals, working alongside an Executive Coach, an Executive Assistant, an Accountability Partner and a Cognitive Behavioral Mindset Coach.

Frequently asked questions

Who needs a chief of staff?

Traditionally, CEOs and senior leaders whose time is the bottleneck. The same problem hits founders, operators and parents: more inputs than hours, and every follow-up living in their head. An AI chief of staff brings the routine part of the job to people who would never hire one.

Is chief of staff a senior role?

Usually, yes. A chief of staff works directly for an executive and often sits in leadership meetings, though the scope varies a lot from one organization to the next. The AI version described on this site is personal: it works for one person and their own day.

What is a personal chief of staff?

A personal chief of staff manages one person's priorities across work and life rather than a company's. A Player Mode does this as an app: it covers Mind, Body and Spirit by default, so family, health and admin sit in the same plan as work.
